name: Teppo
source:
A program that [url=/c48743]Hikari[/url] created in order to investigate [url=/c39368]Saki[/url] and [url=/c39366]Finnel's[/url] mutliple personae issues.
Teppo is an acronym for his real name, Trans Encoder & Personable Program Optimizer.
You see him by installing him as a plug-in. When [url=/c39367]Aoto[/url] Dives into them, Teppo keeps him company. Teppo is capable of detecting cracks in their minds and repairing them.

[From [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/atq/]official site[/url]]
